summary: A modal failure report with the reference code a user reads out to support and a copy button. Presentational: the caller passes the translated texts and the code. Controlled by the open input.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Shows the dialog as a native modal <dialog>; the caller sets it back to false after closed.

inputs.name: message
inputs.description: What went wrong and what to do (translated); describes the dialog.

inputs.name: referenceLabel
inputs.description: The label above the reference code (translated).

inputs.name: referenceCode
inputs.description: The short code support looks the failure up by; shown left-to-right. Without it the reference block is hidden.

inputs.name: copyLabel
inputs.description: The copy button's label (translated); without it there is no copy button.

inputs.name: copiedLabel
inputs.description: The copy button's label right after a copy, also announced politely (translated).

outputs.name: closed
outputs.description: The close button or Escape was pressed.

outputs.name: copied
outputs.description: The code was written to the clipboard (DGA_CLIPBOARD); emits the code.

a11y: Native modal <dialog> with role=alertdialog and aria-modal, named by the title and described by the message. Focus moves to the close button on open, Tab stays inside, Escape closes and focus returns to the opener. The code is dir=ltr so it is never reordered in Arabic; a successful copy is announced through an aria-live=polite region.
